utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll keep spreading the word and see what else they still need for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — I really appreciate it. Let me know what else they need, and I’ll help keep things on track for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Rosa — I’ll ask around and let you know what supplies or hands they still need for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Quinn. Before I say yes, can you tell me what still needs doing for the repair drive at the community center on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair drive details this afternoon, and then we can get the word out together.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Quinn. Send the details this afternoon, and then I’ll know exactly what I can take on.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard the latest myself—what’s the word on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — I can help with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Dane — I heard it’s been moved to Sunday at the community center. We could still use a few more hands, if you’re up for it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Cleo — I’m still in for the repair drive and can help however you need. If you’ve got a spot for the tools Gus mentioned, I can bring them by while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Ira — if you can drop the tools by my place, I’ll keep them together for the repair drive. We’re still sorting the last few supplies, so your help is very welcome.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll swing by with the tools while I’m out. Just let me know if you need anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center now. We could still use spare gloves, a marker, and a few small tools if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I can bring a marker and a couple small tools. I’ll see if I can track down some gloves too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Jules — that helps a lot. See you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive get enough volunteers, or do you still need more hands?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: We could still use a few more hands, and it’s now on Sunday at the community center. If you can help, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I can help on Sunday at the community center. Do you want me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Please note Sunday at the community center for the repair drive. I can work around pickup and drop-off, so just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll keep spreading the word and remind folks it’s Sunday at the community center for the repair drive. I’ll let everyone know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. If anything shifts, just let me know and I’ll adjust around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks for the update — Sunday at the community center works, but I want to make sure I’ve got the right time and can get there on time.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s set for Sunday at the community center; I’ll send the exact time so you can plan on it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — I’ll watch for the exact time and plan my ride so I can get there on time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yes, please — the spare gloves, marker, and a few small tools would be a huge help. I’m still a bit short on tools and spare parts for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still set to help with the repair drive today, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yes, I’m still set to help today — and thanks, that extra gear would really help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thanks for the update—Sunday at the community center works. I’ll keep that in mind and help with whatever’s still left for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks, Mara. I’ll note Sunday at the community center and keep tracking what’s left for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — Sunday at the community center at 2 works for me. Just let me know what still needs doing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I can bring over a few tools and help with whatever still needs doing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. See you Sunday at the community center at 2.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, Sunday at the community center at 2. Easy to mix up, but that’s the spot for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks for clearing that up — Sunday at the community center at 2, got it. I’ll be there with my gloves and flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks Oren — see you Sunday at the community center at 2.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center now. If you’re still helping, I can fill in whatever’s left for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m still helping, and Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll spread the word and bring the details over this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks, Quinn — that’ll help a lot. I’ll be at the community center Sunday and can plug in wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Cleo. I’ll wait for your update, and I’ve noted the repair drive is Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Leo — I’ll check what we’re still short on and send you an update soon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with supplies or timing—do you know what’s still missing for Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we still need to confirm a final supply list and who’s bringing what. I’m just trying to make sure I have the place and time right for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds right — I can help track the supply list and check who’s bringing what. Just let me know if you want me to follow up with anyone.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—thanks for the reminder. I’ll come by Sunday at the community center and bring my gloves and flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh nice, that sounds really helpful. I’ll see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, see you then — if I forget anything, give me a nudge!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around and pass along the list of tools and supplies they still need. So far, Sunday at the community center is the plan, and it sounds like they could use a few extra hands too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—send me the list, and I can bring whatever tools I’ve got and help out on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll ask around and send you the list as soon as I get it. Sunday at the community center is still the plan, and extra hands will definitely be appreciated.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’re set for Sunday at the community center, right? Do you still need me to bring anything besides the gloves and flashlight?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still set to help with the repair drive on Sunday, right?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, I’m still set for Sunday at the community center. I’ll bring the gloves and flashlight unless you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s on Sunday at the community center now, right? I can help, but I’d like to know what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s Sunday at the community center now. I’m checking what still needs doing before we jump in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good — once you know, please lay it out step by step. I’m ready to help with whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center. If you’d like, I can help you figure out the next task.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — that helps. I can take the next task if you tell me what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — we still need a hand sorting supplies and setting up the tables at the community center. If you can take that, I’ll keep the rest organized.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — I’m still a bit short on tools and spare parts for the repair drive this Saturday. If you hear of any extras, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye out for any extra tools or spare parts and let you know right away. Saturday’s still good on my end.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks — Saturday still works for me too. I’ll keep gathering what I can for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m still catching up too—last I heard, it moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Right, Sunday at the community center now. What do you need me to help with?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Mostly I’m just making sure I’ve got the details right—if you know whether they still need volunteers, that’d help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, it’s Sunday at the community center now. I’ll swing by and help if you still need me.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ve got it set for Sunday at the community center. I’ll track that location first for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — Sunday at the community center it is. I’ll see you there and help out if you need me.
